must-read.title: Fed Faces High Stakes Test at Jackson Hole
must-read.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh heads into Jackson Hole under heightened scrutiny after the Treasury’s intervention in the bond market raised questions about the traditional boundaries between fiscal and monetary policy. Host of Bloomberg Money Tom Keene and Veda Partners Co-Founder Henrietta Treyz are on Bloomberg This Weekend and discuss how investors will be watching for how Warsh addresses inflation, market volatility and Fed independence as economic and geopolitical uncertainty complicate the outlook. (Source: Bloomberg)
must-read.title_cn: 美联储在杰克逊霍尔面临高风险考验
must-read.summary_cn: 美联储主席凯文·沃什在财政部的债券市场干预引发对财政与货币政策传统界限的质疑后，带着高度审视走进杰克逊霍尔。彭博财经节目《本周彭博》主持人汤姆·基恩以及Veda Partners联合创始人亨利埃塔·特雷兹在节目中讨论，投资者将关注沃什如何回应通胀、市场波动和美联储独立性，因为经济和地缘政治不确定性使前景更加复杂。（来源：彭博）
must-read.ai_summary: 美联储主席凯文·沃什前往杰克逊霍尔参加会议，在财政部干预债券市场引发对财政和货币政策之间传统边界问题的质疑后，他面临着更加严格的审查。《彭博财经》主持人汤姆·基恩和Veda Partners联合创始人亨利埃塔·特雷兹在《彭博周末》节目中讨论了投资者将如何关注沃什如何应对通胀、市场波动和美联储独立性，因为经济和地缘政治的不确定性使前景更加复杂。（来源：彭博）

must-read.title: Treasury Buybacks Fail to Calm Bond Market
must-read.summary: The Treasury’s surprise decision to at least double buybacks of longer-dated US debt briefly pushed yields lower, but much of that move quickly reversed as investors questioned whether the intervention can overcome inflation and fiscal concerns. PIMCO Executive VP, Market Strategist and Generalist Portfolio Manger Tony Crescenzi and Host of Bloomberg Money Tom Keene join Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss how markets are now looking to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech for clues on rates and how the central bank will respond to Treasury’s increasingly active role in the bond market. (Source: Bloomberg)
must-read.title_cn: 国债回购未能安抚债券市场
must-read.summary_cn: 美国财政部的意外决定至少将长期美国国债的回购规模翻倍，短暂压低了收益率，但随后大部分涨幅迅速回落，因为投资者质疑干预能否克服通胀和财政担忧。PIMCO执行副总裁、市场策略师兼全权组合经理托尼·克雷森齐与彭博《周末财经》主持人汤姆·基恩共同出席，讨论市场现在如何寄望于美联储主席凯文·沃什在杰克逊霍尔的讲话，以寻找利率线索以及央行将如何应对财政部在债券市场上日益积极的角色。（来源：彭博）
must-read.ai_summary: 财政部出人意料地决定至少将长期美国国债的回购规模翻倍，这一度短暂压低了收益率，但随着投资者质疑这项干预措施能否克服通胀和财政担忧，这一走势很快逆转。PIMCO执行副总裁、市场策略师兼综合投资组合经理托尼·克雷申齐与彭博财经节目主持人汤姆·基恩共同做客《彭博周末》节目，讨论市场如何期待美联储主席凯文·沃什在杰克逊霍尔的讲话，以寻找利率走向的线索，以及央行将如何应对财政部在债券市场中日益积极的角色。（来源：彭博）

must-read.summary: Bond investors will zero in on Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech this week, with a further selloff in long-dated Treasuries at stake as markets look for clues on the Federal Reserve chairman’s response to persistent inflation and fiscal concerns.

must-read.title: A Teen’s Double Life Reveals London’s Wealth Obsession
must-read.summary: Joining Bloomberg This Weekend is Best Selling Author Patrick Radden Keefe to discuss his new book 'London Falling,' which explores the mysterious 2019 death of 19-year-old Zac Brettler, whose parents discovered after his death that he had been posing as the son of a Russian oligarch. Keefe explains to Christina Ruffini that the story examines London’s influx of extreme wealth and social media-fueled status anxiety while tracing a family’s effort to understand the secret life their son had built. (Source: Bloomberg)
must-read.title_cn: 一个青少年的双重生活揭示了伦敦对财富的痴迷
must-read.summary_cn: 本周末，畅销书作家帕特里克·雷登·基夫将加入Bloomberg，讨论他的新书《London Falling》。该书探讨了2019年19岁的扎克·布雷特勒的神秘死亡，他的父母在他去世后发现，他一直假扮俄罗斯寡头的儿子。基夫向克里斯蒂娜·鲁菲尼解释，这个故事审视了伦敦极端财富的涌入以及社交媒体驱动的身份焦虑，同时追踪了这家人试图理解儿子所建立的秘密生活的努力。（来源：Bloomberg）

大国博弈.title: Alliance Tested as Trump Pulls Out of South Korea Drill
大国博弈.summary: The US and South Korea sharply curtailed their annual military exercises after President Donald Trump ordered them scaled back, surprising Seoul as North Korea expands its nuclear and missile capabilities and deepens military ties with Russia. Bloomberg Economics and Senior Geoeconomics Analyst Adam Farrar is on Bloomberg This Weekend with David Gura and Christina Ruffini and explains that move comes as the US shifts an aircraft carrier and other military resources from the Indo-Pacific toward the Middle East, raising questions about Washington’s ability to sustain its security commitments in Asia. (Source: Bloomberg)

大国博弈.summary_cn: 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普下令缩减规模后，美国和韩国大幅削减了年度军事演习，令首尔感到意外，因为朝鲜正在扩大其核武和导弹能力，并深化与俄罗斯的军事关系。彭博经济学高级地缘经济分析师亚当·法拉尔在《彭博周末》节目中与大卫·古拉以及克里斯蒂娜·拉菲尼共同出席，他解释道，此举正值美国将一艘航空母舰及其他军事资源从印太地区调往中东，这引发了对华盛顿能否在亚洲维持安全承诺的能力的质疑。（来源：彭博）

大国博弈.title: US Push to Isolate Iran Runs Into China
大国博弈.summary: The Trump administration is preparing additional measures to isolate Iran’s economy, but further pressure could mean targeting China, the dominant buyer of Iranian oil. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the situation with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini is Bloomberg News Senior Editor Wendy Benjaminson. (Source: Bloomberg)

大国博弈.title: Can Canada Still Trust America on Trade?
大国博弈.summary: Chrystia Freeland says a tentative US-Canada trade agreement may prevent new US tariffs from taking effect, but only if Canada makes major concessions including easing retaliation, allowing US alcohol back into provincial stores and aligning with Washington on some digital issues. Existing US tariffs on Canadian steel, aluminum, cars and auto parts would remain, though at lower levels. Freeland says that would mark a major shift from Canada’s long-held position that such tariffs violate USMCA, and could hurt both countries, especially US manufacturing and the Detroit-Windsor auto supply chain. But decades of decline, record-low snowpack and shrinking reservoirs have pushed the system toward crisis, with Lake Powell nearing levels that could threaten hydropower production. As key rules expire and states fail to reach a long-term deal, the federal government is stepping in with proposed cuts to lower-basin water use, hitting Arizona especially hard. Will the Southwest be able to survive on a shrinking Colorado River? (Source: Bloomberg)
